claims.claim: On ten Meta-World tasks, TimeRewarder reports nearly perfect success in 9 of 10 tasks with 200,000 environment interactions per task (Abstract).
claims.evidence: The logbook states Meta-World/DrQ-v2 training is unavailable, so no downstream RL experiments were run to test the nearly-perfect success claim.

raw_verdict.overall: This logbook verifies the paper's theoretical derivations under stated assumptions and performs a limited sanity check of released checkpoint temporal-distance predictions on a small fixed video set, but does not reproduce reward-model training, baseline comparisons, or any downstream RL experiments. Most experimental claims remain unaddressed due to missing baselines, rollout data, and training infrastructure.
